why: The rerun of owner review 1 (docs/v3/cycles/owner-review-1.md § Findings 1, 3, 4 and 5) rebuilt seven pages on the fixed kit. The owner's n35 remark ('horrible rendering') is only partly met because the shipped IntervalTrack cuts titles; and three defects on his themes remain in shipped parts that fresh builders used as documented.
what: Four kit fixes, each shown on the rerun's shots in .evidence/v3-shots/owner-review-1/r0 on the dev host.
change: (1) IntervalTrack span labels: a title that does not fit takes a short form or drops by priority with the span still named in the readout and the live region, instead of an ellipsis on every span; a label never sits inside another span's outline (n35: nine ellipsised titles at 1800, three named at 390, 'Lunch' inside the longest free block). (2) ChainView in a panel narrower than its columns: scroll with a cue, or lay out to the width, and allow a node title two lines (n32: the third column cut at the panel edge at 1800). (3) The axis hover readout: an x readout hides the tick labels it covers, and a y readout formats through y.format (c12 'Sat 7' over 'Fri 6' at 390, n04 'Sa Sat 07:00', n15 '29 Sep' against the crosshair, n02 '0.13333333333333×'). (4) Diagnose c12's BarList focusSeries link that holds only on a direct arrival at 1800 (the LIST line of the rerun's shoot log); cycle 6 fixed that crossing loss for tables, so check the BarList arm.
acceptance: n35's rerun scenario at 1800 shows no ellipsised span title, and at 390 every span is named in the readout or by label
n32's rerun scenario at 1800 shows the chain's last column whole, or a visible scroll cue
The x hover readout on c12, n04 and n15 overprints no tick label at 1800 or 390; n02's y readout prints its formatted value
c12's list frame links on the stepped path, or the finding is closed with the cause named
